lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five to six horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots are distributed across the visible lateral flank. In the area posterior to the gills, the spots exhibit a semi-regular grid arrangement with approximately 10-12 visible columns.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming a discernible grid pattern where blobs serve as anchor nodes within the vertical bands.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible across the upper flank. Each ridge is defined by a sharp intensity gradient transition from high-luminance upper edges to shadow-dominated lower edges, extending from the gill region toward the caudal peduncle.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible first dorsal fin contains approximately five high-luminance blobs. These are sparsely distributed, primarily located toward the trailing edge and base of the fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a high density of smaller, more tightly packed high-luminance blobs compared to the primary flank grid pattern.
